event: Paramartha composes/transmits the Life of Vasubandhu: Purusapura origin, brother Asanga, death at Ayodhya aged 80; its internal nirvana-interval figures are tradition arithmetic, not record
firmness_reason: Author's own dates are Chinese-recorded and the text survives only in Chinese; its factual content is one inferential step from record and its interval numbers are demonstrably unreliable
notes: Campaign case 5: primary biographical source for the pair; use its facts, refuse its numbers.
